mechanics.claim: Puts all units hit into stasis and stuns enemy champions, minions, and turrets for the same duration.
mechanics.quote: it puts all units within into {{tip|stasis}} for {{fd|2.5}} seconds, as well as {{tip|stun|stunning}} all enemy {{tip|champions}}, {{tip|minions}}, and {{tip|turret|turrets}} struck for the same duration

mechanics.claim: Tempered Fate deals 0 true damage on hit, which still triggers on-hit/in-combat effects.
mechanics.quote: ''Tempered Fate'' deals 0 {{tip|proc damage|proc}} {{tip|true damage}}, which triggers [[combat status|in-combat]] effects such as drawing turret and [[Monster#Monster_Behavior|monster aggression]], {{ri|Sudden Impact}} or applying {{ii|Elixir of Sorcery}}

mechanics.claim: Travel time varies with distance, delaying impact by roughly 1.15 to 2.3 seconds including cast time.
mechanics.quote: ''Tempered Fate's'' travel time varies between ~{{fd|0.65}} at point blank and ~{{fd|1.8}} at max range, resulting in an overall delay of ~{{fd|1.15}}-{{fd|2.3}} seconds including the cast time depending on distance covered.
